name: @skein-code/cli
description: A context-first, model-agnostic coding agent with an auditable terminal workspace.

releaseNotes: Named primary connections now target third-party compatible relays only, use explicit env or none authentication, and resolve one complete profile automatically while requiring an explicit choice for ambiguity
OpenAI Responses is the recommended new transport with POST /responses, store false, typed SSE, normalized tools and usage, and bounded exact output-item replay for stateless reasoning continuation
OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages remain explicit relay transports without cross-protocol retries; inference and OpenAI-style model catalog base URLs are configured independently
Relay model discovery now uses a bounded 15-minute ETag cache isolated by endpoint and credential fingerprints, invalidates authentication failures, and never stores or echoes credential values

First-run and agents setup flows are relay-only, save only credential environment-variable names, and expose redacted connection state consistently across TUI, text, JSON, JSONL, doctor, and config output
Provider diagnostics redact secrets, authorization headers, URL credentials, and query strings while Responses replay state is capped at 128 items and 4 MiB in memory and persisted sessions
External delegated CLIs now receive a minimal runtime-owned environment instead of inheriting provider, Skein, relay, or NODE_OPTIONS secrets
TERM=dumb and screen-reader sessions now use deterministic ASCII, monochrome, reduced-motion, non-incremental rendering without losing keyboard input
SKEIN_SCREEN_READER=1 enables Ink accessibility output with semantic timeline, permission, and composer roles plus clean phase boundaries
PTY release gates now replay eight terminal scenarios through a headless emulator and reject final-frame overflow, stale panels, announcement joins, and missing status
A local terminal UI benchmark enforces 25 ms input and 150 ms streaming-render p95 budgets while retaining the final streamed chunk
MCP trust and revoke confirmation rendering now has a deterministic cross-platform release regression gate
MCP now follows a no-network search and inspect review before explicit workspace-bound manifest trust and lazy activation
Declarative capability manifests expose redacted source, version, tools, permissions, network, command, path, sensitive-field, process, and completion-evidence effects
Persistent disable and revoke unload active remote schemas while manifest fingerprint changes fail closed to untrusted
Server annotations cannot lower local permissions, named manifests reject injected undeclared schemas, and optional server failures remain isolated
Only explicitly required trusted MCP servers may block startup, while status inspection no longer connects optional servers
Sensitive MCP arguments are redacted from terminal, TUI, JSON, and approval events; unsupported external mutations remain completion-unresolved
Explain and review intents expose smaller built-in schema sets, and MCP activation reports deterministic eager-versus-loaded schema estimates plus top-match evidence
First-run setup now states that the primary agent needs API credentials and that provider subscriptions or signed-in coding CLIs are separate delegated tools
Permission prompts show the policy reason, redacted target, working directory, category risk, and explicit once, session, deny, and stop choices
The Recovery Center joins last-run state, failure repair hints, changed files, checkpoints, diff, audit, rollback, retry, and safe session resume
Read-only review commands pin working-tree, commit, or branch scope and inject a content-free redacted evidence bundle without storing it in the user transcript
JSON and JSONL terminal records now follow the published headless v1 schema with stable completed, verification, input, blocked, cancellation, turn, token, and error exit codes
Short terminal viewports clip long lists without overflow and pending clarifications cannot be consumed by recovery commands
Durable sessions now separate a 250k-token context epoch from a 1m-token lifetime ceiling without changing the session id or deleting transcript history
Content-free epoch handoffs preserve Task Contract criteria, unresolved failure circuits, changed files, and verification receipts across long runs
Intent Sufficiency routes clear requests to execution, repository-inferable gaps to inspection, and genuine product choices to one persisted clarification
TUI and headless output expose epoch, lifetime, and needs-input state; queued follow-ups pause and resume after keyboard clarification instead of becoming accidental answers
Successful identical tool calls clear matching historical failure signatures from later epoch handoffs
Context compaction now rebuilds authoritative task, working-state, verification, permission, failure, and artifact facts outside generated narrative
Automatic compaction runs only when three predicted prompt reuses produce positive net token savings while explicit compact commands remain available
Compaction provider usage is included in session totals with separate content-free actual or estimated receipts
Empty or lossy narratives cannot erase deterministic facts, and the complete persisted transcript remains unchanged
Normal chat startup now exposes a compact mcp_activate catalog instead of eagerly connecting MCP servers
MCP activation connects one selected server, discovers remote tools, and loads at most eight relevant schemas
Explicit MCP diagnostics can still connect eagerly while all MCP activation and remote calls remain network operations
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini usage now normalizes cached input, cache-write input, and reasoning tokens when reported
Token Ledger, session totals, and structured usage events preserve provider cache and reasoning counts without prompt content
Streaming, non-streaming, explicit-zero, and legacy-session compatibility paths are covered without claiming cache activation
Failed configured verification output yields bounded current-run diagnostic ranking without persisting paths
Diagnostic hints cannot create zero-relevance hits and are cleared on success or the next agent run
Python absolute and relative module imports now contribute deterministic offline graph adjacency
Context provenance exposes the diagnostic score alongside graph and isolated Git recency signals
Local index v3 records TypeScript AST definitions, calls, and relative import adjacency for graph-assisted retrieval
Context hits expose generation, content hash, matched terms, and bm25/path/symbol/phrase/graph score provenance
Context benchmark v2 locks multilingual recall, MRR, useful-token, stale-hit, incremental-index, and warm-latency gates
Large MCP catalogs now disclose at most eight request-relevant schemas per run while preserving network permissions
Token Ledger receipts report deferred progressive schemas and selected definitions remain stable across tool turns
A deterministic Token Economy replay benchmark guards evidence, output-firewall, and no-progress invariants
Calibrated Type-1/2 duplication matches now block completion until reuse or exact audited suppression
Type-3 duplication remains warning-only and Type-4 semantic equivalence remains explicitly unsupported
Duplication benchmark fixtures report deterministic recall, precision, false-positive rate, and latency
Duplication warnings now aggregate into the single completion receipt without changing verified status
Exact match ids support bounded, reason-coded suppression with audit and credential/code-block safeguards
Duplication audit tools are disclosed only when active warnings exist and repaired paths clear stale matches
Warning-only TS/JS duplication audit compares new functions with the pre-write index generation
Deterministic Type-1/2 and Type-3 receipts retain only hashes, locations, scores, and bounded counts
Ordinary edits, renames, moves, deletions, small functions, tests, generated paths, and failed writes stay quiet
Warning-only Reuse Gate records content-free candidate evidence before the first substantive write
Reuse receipts surface unresolved index/read failures instead of claiming a safe new implementation
Prompt and timeline diagnostics expose the repository-first reuse ladder without blocking legitimate writes
Known tool changes refresh only their affected local-index paths before the next model turn
File ctime closes same-size and restored-mtime zero-hit freshness gaps without full-content scans
Repeated empty or unchanged search calls stop through the existing recovery circuit
Git recency is an isolated, bounded tie-break with exact HEAD-bound cache invalidation and non-Git degradation

scripts.release:verify: npm run check && npm run verify:package --
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist
